_comment: Seed list of public ATS boards to ingest. Greenhouse uses a board token (boards.greenhouse.io/<token>); Lever uses jobs.lever.co/<company>; Ashby uses api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<organization>. These feeds are public and need no API key. Grow this list from companies you care about and from titles you ingest via aggregators. Copy to board_tokens.json (gitignored) before running ingest at scale.
